cond_0001.intro: We are looking for an Inventory Analyst to join our team. This position supports adherence to standards and policies, training, reporting, and providing insight related to global hotel inventory. This includes analyzing and auditing inventory data and transactions to ensure targets and financial goals are met. Supports the team and business partners with [Product name masked] and shoreside inventory systems.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Analyze monthly business reports to ensure all hotel inventory teams on all vessels are in compliance with set targets, policies and practices.
Draft and/or manage data and reporting requests for internal business partners.
Work with Scheduling team to ensure crew member schedule meets par needs for onboard inventory department for all brands.
Provide guidance and training to ships and internal business partners regarding [Product name masked] and stock management.
Support the replenishment, order processing, cycle counting and reporting needs for hotel inventory held at warehouses around the world.
Assist in the planning and execution for new programs or products.
Make recommendations to drive efficiencies within the inventory program and supply chain in general.
Support updating and publishing the Inventory Manager Manual for SQM and other Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) documentation.
Assist Manager, as required, in implementing initiatives, goals and objectives that support the fleet and senior management.
Assist the team with reviewing financial data and transactions related to inventory assets and inventory adjustments for financial reporting. Creating journal entry requests.
Performs other duties as required.

Minimum Requirements
1-2 Years' experience in supply chain management and/or logistics or 1-3 years' experience in statistics, business modeling, or forecasting.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and multitask.
Must be a self-starter, with the ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
Must be detail oriented to ensure accuracy in analysis and presentations along with strong operational focus.
Interpersonal skills to communicate with all levels of management and employees.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions, inquiries and complaints from management, customers, and the general public.
Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
Preferred Requirements
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college in accounting, finance, hospitality management, business administration, or related field or the international equivalent.
Knowledgeable in Hotel and Food & Beverage provisioning.

Deliver guidance and training to ships and internal business partners on [Product name masked] and stock management.

The role also supports team members and business partners with [Product name masked] and shoreside inventory systems.
cond_0483.responsibilities:
Analyze monthly business reports to ensure all hotel inventory teams on all vessels are in compliance with set targets, policies and practices. Regularly connect with internal business partners to draft and/or manage data and reporting requests. Work closely with the Scheduling team to ensure crew member schedules meet par needs for the onboard inventory department for all brands. Provide guidance and training to ships and internal business partners regarding [Product name masked] and stock management — walking teams through processes and handling questions as they come up. Support the replenishment, order processing, cycle counting and reporting needs for hotel inventory held at warehouses around the world. Assist in the planning and execution for new programs or products. Actively contribute recommendations to drive efficiencies within the inventory program and supply chain. Support updating and publishing the Inventory Manager Manual for SQM and other Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) documentation. Assist Manager, as required, in implementing initiatives, goals and objectives that support the fleet and senior management.
Assist the team with reviewing financial data and transactions related to inventory assets and inventory adjustments for financial reporting. Creating journal entry requests.

Knowledgeable in Hotel and Food & Beverage provisioning.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and multitask.

cond_0608.responsibilities:

Work with Scheduling team to ensure crew member schedule meets par needs for onboard inventory department for all brands.
Provide guidance and training to ships and internal business partners regarding [Product name masked] and stock management.
Support the replenishment, order processing, cycle counting and reporting needs for the hotel inventory held at warehouses around the world.

Knowledgeable in Hotel and Food & Beverage provisioning.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and multitask.
Must be a self-starter, with the ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
Must be detail oriented to ensure accuracy in analysis and presentations along with strong operational focus.
Interpersonal skills to communicate with all levels of management and employees.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions, inquiries and complaints from management, customers, and the general public.
